Legal, But Still Denied――前澤友作の社債スキームから見るEconomic Rationality

Can a tax authority deny a transaction even when each step is legal? 前澤友作氏の資産管理会社をめぐる社債取引を入口に、法人税法132条の行為計算否認を追った。At first, it looked like tax law was judging someone's hidden intention. But the deeper point was more objective: whether the transaction has economic rationality beyond its tax effect. Silence does not make a structure disappear.
